answer: Every identity holds one saffron thread on the ocean board: a single open claim, the next opens only after the first clears verified. A beacon warden reads the board within an hour of each claim; a second open thread is a tangled thread, both claims void, identity barred a week. One honest worker pays five cents and one real job per cycle; a farmer with 1,000 fakes pays $50 and must finish 1,000 real jobs before any identity claims again.
